[](List_of_personal_coats_of_arms_of_presidents_of_the_United_States "List of personal coats of arms of presidents of the United States") | | | **William Jefferson Clinton** ([né](Birth_name "Birth name") **Blythe III**; born August 19, 1946) is an American politician who served as the 42nd [president of the United States](President_of_the_United_States "President of the United States") from 1993 to 2001. A member of the [Democratic Party](Democratic_Party_(United_States) "Democratic Party (United States)"), he previously served as [governor of Arkansas](Governor_of_Arkansas "Governor of Arkansas") from 1979 to 1981 and again from 1983 to 1992. Clinton, whose policies reflected a [centrist](Centrist "Centrist") "[Third Way](Third_Way "Third Way")" political philosophy, became known as a [New Democrat](New_Democrat "New Democrat"). He is the husband of [Hillary Clinton](Hillary_Clinton "Hillary Clinton"), who was a [U.S. senator](U.S._senator "U.S. senator") from [New York](New_York_(state) "New York (state)") from 2001 to 2009, [secretary of state](United_States_Secretary_of_State "United States Secretary of State") from 2009 to 2013 and the Democratic nominee for president in [2016](2016_United_States_presidential_election "2016 United States presidential election"). Clinton was born and raised in and attended [Georgetown University](Georgetown_University "Georgetown University"). He received a [Rhodes Scholarship](Rhodes_Scholarship "Rhodes Scholarship") to study at [University College, Oxford](University_College%2C_Oxford "University College, Oxford"), and later graduated from [Yale Law School](Yale_Law_School "Yale Law School"). He met Hillary Rodham at Yale; they married in 1975. After graduating from law school, Clinton returned to Arkansas and won election as state attorney general, followed by [two non-consecutive tenures as Arkansas governor](Governorships_of_Bill_Clinton "Governorships of Bill Clinton"). As governor, he overhauled the state's education system and served as chairman of the [National Governors Association](National_Governors_Association "National Governors Association"). Clinton was elected president in the [1992 presidential election](1992_United_States_presidential_election "1992 United States presidential election"), defeating incumbent [Republican](Republican_Party_(United_States) "Republican Party (United States)") president [George H. W. Bush](George_H._W._Bush "George H. W. Bush") and [independent](Independent_politician "Independent politician") businessman [Ross Perot](Ross_Perot "Ross Perot"). At 46 years old, he became the [third-youngest](List_of_presidents_of_the_United_States_by_age "List of presidents of the United States by age") president of the United States and the first president to be born in the [Baby Boomer](Baby_Boomer "Baby Boomer") generation. Clinton presided over the longest period of peacetime economic expansion in American history. He signed into law the [North American Free Trade Agreement](North_American_Free_Trade_Agreement "North American Free Trade Agreement") (NAFTA) and the [Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act](Violent_Crime_Control_and_Law_Enforcement_Act "Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act"), but failed to pass his plan for [national health care reform](Clinton_health_care_plan_of_1993 "Clinton health care plan of 1993"). The Republican Party [won unified control](Republican_Revolution "Republican Revolution") of Congress for the first time in 40 years in the [1994 elections](1994_United_States_elections "1994 United States elections"), but Clinton was still comfortably re-elected president in [1996](1996_United_States_presidential_election "1996 United States presidential election") against both Republican [Bob Dole](Bob_Dole "Bob Dole") and Perot—now the [Reform Party](Reform_Party_of_the_United_States_of_America "Reform Party of the United States of America") nominee—becoming the first Democrat since [Franklin D. Roosevelt](Franklin_D._Roosevelt "Franklin D. Roosevelt") to win a second full term. Starting in the mid-1990s, he began an ideological evolution as he became much more conservative in his domestic policy, advocating for and signing the [Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Act](Personal_Responsibility_and_Work_Opportunity_Act "Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Act"), the [State Children's Health Insurance Program](State_Children's_Health_Insurance_Program "State Children's Health Insurance Program") and financial deregulation measures. He appointed [Ruth Bader Ginsburg](Ruth_Bader_Ginsburg "Ruth Bader Ginsburg") and [Stephen Breyer](Stephen_Breyer "Stephen Breyer") to the [U.S. Supreme Court](U.S._Supreme_Court "U.S. Supreme Court"). During the last three years of Clinton's presidency, the [Congressional Budget Office](Congressional_Budget_Office "Congressional Budget Office") reported a budget surplus—the first such surplus since 1969. In foreign policy, Clinton ordered U.S. military intervention in the [Bosnian](Bosnian_War "Bosnian War") and [Kosovo](Kosovo_War "Kosovo War") wars, eventually signing the [Dayton Peace agreement](Dayton_Agreement "Dayton Agreement"). He also called for the [expansion of NATO](Expansion_of_NATO "Expansion of NATO") in Eastern Europe and many former [Warsaw Pact](Warsaw_Pact "Warsaw Pact") members joined NATO during his presidency. Clinton's foreign policy in the Middle East saw him sign the [Iraq Liberation Act](Iraq_Liberation_Act "Iraq Liberation Act") which gave aid to groups against [Saddam Hussein](Saddam_Hussein "Saddam Hussein"). He also participated in the [Oslo I Accord](Oslo_I_Accord "Oslo I Accord") and [Camp David Summit](2000_Camp_David_Summit "2000 Camp David Summit") to advance the [Israeli–Palestinian peace process](Israeli%E2%80%93Palestinian_peace_process "Israeli–Palestinian peace process"), and assisted the [Northern Ireland peace process](Northern_Ireland_peace_process "Northern Ireland peace process"). Clinton's second term was dominated by the [Clinton–Lewinsky scandal](Clinton%E2%80%93Lewinsky_scandal "Clinton–Lewinsky scandal"), which began in 1995, when he had a sexual relationship with 22-year-old [White House](White_House "White House") intern [Monica Lewinsky](Monica_Lewinsky "Monica Lewinsky"). In January 1998, news of the affair made tabloid headlines.[[1]](Bill_Clinton#cite_note-1) This scandal escalated throughout the year, culminating on December 19 when [Clinton was impeached](Impeachment_of_Bill_Clinton "Impeachment of Bill Clinton") by the [House of Representatives](United_States_House_of_Representatives "United States House of Representatives"), becoming the second U.S. president—the first since [Andrew Johnson](Andrew_Johnson "Andrew Johnson")—to be impeached. Roosevelt and [Ronald Reagan](Ronald_Reagan "Ronald Reagan"). Bush") formed the [Clinton Bush Haiti Fund](Clinton_Bush_Haiti_Fund "Clinton Bush Haiti Fund").
